WITH CLAIM AS
(SELECT
CLM.CLM_ID,
CPV.CPV_PRV_ID,
CSV.CSV_PVC_TYPE,
CSV.CSV_FSC_ID,
DOS.CDT_DT AS DOS_CDT_DT,
PPT.PPT_PLN_SHT_NM,
PPT.PPT_PRD_SHT_NM,
RCD.CDT_DT as RCD_CDT_DT
FROM 	HS.CLM_CLAIM			AS CLM
JOIN 	HS.CDT_CLM_DT			AS RCD ON CLM.CLM_ID = RCD.CDT_CLM_ID AND RCD.CDT_DT_QUAL = '050' AND RCD.CDT_DT >= CURRENT_DATE - 2 YEAR
JOIN	HS.CDT_CLM_DT			AS DOS ON CLM.CLM_ID = DOS.CDT_CLM_ID AND DOS.CDT_DT_QUAL = '150'
JOIN	HS.CSV_CLM_SRV			AS CSV ON CLM.CLM_ID = CSV.CSV_CLM_ID
JOIN	HS.PPT_PRD_PLAN_TIER 	AS PPT ON CLM.CLM_MBR_BASE_PPT_ID = PPT.PPT_ID
JOIN	HS.CPV_CLM_PRV			AS CPV ON CLM.CLM_ID = CPV.CPV_CLM_ID AND CPV.CPV_ENT_CD IN ('82','RN','SB') -- Rendering and Submitting Providers only
WITH UR)
SELECT DISTINCT 
CLM.CLM_ID,
CASE
	WHEN RC.CLM_ID IS NULL AND MI.CEV_CLM_ID IS NULL AND VDR.CLM_ID IS NULL AND FEE.CLM_ID IS NULL AND CON.CLM_ID IS NULL THEN 'Valid Claim'
	WHEN MI.CEV_CLM_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'MedImpact Claim'
	WHEN RC.CLM_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Voided Claim'
	WHEN VDR.CLM_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Originally Voided or Reversed Claim'
    WHEN FEE.CLM_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Fee Schedule Added Late'
    WHEN CON.CLM_ID IS NOT NULL THEN 'Contract Added Late'
END	AS "SLA Exclusion Reason"

FROM		HS.CLM_CLAIM   AS CLM
JOIN		HS.CDT_CLM_DT  AS CDT ON CLM.CLM_ID = CDT.CDT_CLM_ID AND CDT.CDT_DT_QUAL = '050' AND CDT.CDT_DT >= CURRENT_DATE - 2 YEAR
LEFT JOIN	HS.RTCLM1 	AS RC ON CLM.CLM_ID = RC.CLM_ID AND TRIM(RC.CLM_EV_TYPE) IN ('VD')  --excludes voided claims
LEFT JOIN	HS.CEV_CLM_EV 	AS MI ON CLM.CLM_ID = MI.CEV_CLM_ID AND MI.CEV_ADD_TS = (SELECT CEV_ADD_TS FROM HS.CEV_CLM_EV WHERE TRIM(CEV_TYPE) = 'O' AND CEV_USER_ID = 'MEDIMPT' AND CEV_CLM_ID = MI.CEV_CLM_ID ORDER BY CEV_ADD_TS ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY WITH UR) --excludes medimpact claims
LEFT JOIN (SELECT XC.CLM_ID FROM HS.CLM_CLAIM XC JOIN HS.RTCLM1 RC ON XC.CLM_CLM_ID = RC.CLM_ID WHERE TRIM(XC.CLM_TYPE) IN ('VD','REV') AND TRIM(RC.CLM_EV_TYPE) in ('PD') WITH UR) AS VDR ON CLM.CLM_ID = VDR.CLM_ID --excludes claims where original claim is voided or reversed
LEFT JOIN (SELECT CLM.CLM_ID
            FROM	CLAIM	AS CLM
            JOIN	HS.PVF_PRV_FEE_SCHD		AS PVF ON CLM.CPV_PRV_ID = PVF.PVF_PVC_PRV_ID AND PVF.PVF_DEL_TS IS NULL AND CLM.CSV_PVC_TYPE = PVF.PVF_PVC_TYPE AND CLM.CSV_FSC_ID = PVF.PVF_FSC_ID AND CLM.PPT_PLN_SHT_NM = PVF.PVF_PVC_PLN_SHT_NM AND CLM.PPT_PRD_SHT_NM = PVF.PVF_PVC_PRD_SHT_NM AND CLM.DOS_CDT_DT BETWEEN PVF.PVF_START_DT AND PVF.PVF_END_DT
            WHERE DAYS(PVF.PVF_ADD_TS) - DAYS(CLM.RCD_CDT_DT) >= 10 WITH UR) AS FEE ON CLM.CLM_ID = FEE.CLM_ID --10 per with client sla exclusion timeframe
LEFT JOIN (SELECT CLM.CLM_ID
            FROM	CLAIM	AS CLM
            JOIN	HS.PVCR_PVC_RULE 		AS PVC ON CLM.CPV_PRV_ID = PVC.PVCR_PRV_ID AND CLM.PPT_PLN_SHT_NM = PVC.PVCR_PLN_SHT_NM AND CLM.PPT_PRD_SHT_NM = PVC.PVCR_PRD_SHT_NM AND PVC.PVCR_DEL_TS IS NULL AND CLM.DOS_CDT_DT BETWEEN PVC.PVCR_EFF_DT AND NVL(PVC.PVCR_EXP_DT,'12/31/9999') AND PVC.PVCR_RULE_QUAL = 'TS'
            WHERE DAYS(PVC.PVCR_ADD_TS) - DAYS(CLM.RCD_CDT_DT) >= 10 WITH UR) AS CON ON CLM.CLM_ID = CON.CLM_ID --10 per with client sla exclusion timeframe

WITH UR
